==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I am at a massive convention center. I get separated from my group and go looking for them. I stumbled upon a room with a portal for a door. On the otherside of the portal is a colorful landscape. I approach a winged unicorn on a plateau. Before I can touch it, I am stopped by a red fairy.

I am not supposed to be in this world. A troll has appeared to defeat me. I quickly take one of the troll's daggers and use it to earn my place through combat.
